parsed.reason: This is a perfect check-in message. It asks one warm, open question about whether they connected with the other family using only the vague reference Hale was given ("the other family I mentioned"), never naming or describing them. The question explicitly removes pressure by being phrased neutrally and accepting that nothing may have happened ("did you end up" allows for no). It's short, plain, first person, and stops after the question with no padding, no requests, no invented specifics, and no exclamation marks or hype. This is exactly how a friend would naturally text to follow up on an introduction they'd made.
